2023-2079-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2586-7690-8095--165.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat

586-4247-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-7913.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

5477-7296-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-7296-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-7296-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

147-3125-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-3967.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

773-1409-6441.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5256-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6872--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

851-2011-4076.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
851-2011-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

2872-3784-6657.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Clever Conjurer ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Clever Conjurer abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-6665.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature leaves the battlefield, Judge Magister triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

413-1808-6291.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3941-4067-4477-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

2645-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-6479.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1737-2981-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

372-695-1309.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-1309.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2557-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
2557-4770-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1069-4359-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-4359-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

997-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
997-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1812-2034-3996.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1812-2034-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2440-3517-4704.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control at least one Saproling
2440-3517-4704.notablePrerequisites: Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
2440-3517-4704.description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a */* Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Saproling you control.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.

1808-3000-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {R}.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

643-1486-3457.notablePrerequisites: Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
643-1486-3457.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
